visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Shift Instead of Swapping
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each item is moved into place with repeated three-line swaps. Hold the item in a variable, shift the larger ones right and write it once. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A swap writes two items, a shift writes one. Holding the item in key and writing it once saves about two thirds of the writes.
